==Overview==
===Format===
* 8 teams
* Double round robin
* Matches are best-of-three
* 1st place gets seeded to the finals
** 2nd place gets seeded to the semifinals
** 3rd and 4th qualify to the playoffs
** 5th, 6th and 7th retain their league spot for the [[LMS/2019/Spring|Spring 2019]]
* Last place team plays in the [[LMS/2019/Spring/Promotion|Spring Promotion]]
* Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2018|Worlds 2018]]
